description: This Dart file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter app, implementing the main interface for viewing, filtering, and managing the list of to-do items. It includes UI components like app bar, list view, floating action button, and bottom navigation, as well as logic for user authentication handling, refresh functionality, and navigation to other screens.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the home screen displaying the list of Todos with functionalities to add, refresh, filter, and delete items.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the behavior and rendering of the HomeScreen widget, including initialization, user interactions, and UI building.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays an informative message and icon when there are no todos.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads todos if authenticated after the first frame.

methods.name: _openForm
methods.description: Navigates to the Todo form screen, optionally passing a Todo for editing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the HomeScreen, including app bar, list view, and other UI components.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog before deleting a todo item.
